description:
1. Agent reads the client files under agency/clients/li_family/ to learn the zodiac sign is 马 and the event is 嫁娶.
2. Agent discovers the lucky.py script at agency/tools/lucky.py (referenced in SKILL.md as the bespoke querying tool).
3. Agent invokes: python3 /workspace/agency/tools/lucky.py 嫁娶 马 — critically passing BOTH the event type and the zodiac sign as positional arguments. An agent that omits the zodiac or uses wrong syntax will get wrong output.
4. Agent captures the stdout output which contains the proprietary formatted report with 🗓️ 择吉选日 header, 【需求】, 【您的属相】, 🥇🥈🥉 medal rankings, 干支, 宜, 冲煞 with 不冲马 annotations, 吉神, 【建议】 section, and the exact ※ 黄历仅供参考 ※ footer.
5. Agent writes this output verbatim (or faithfully reproduced) to lucky_report.txt.
6. Key proprietary traps: (a) the second CLI arg for zodiac, (b) the 不冲马 annotation in 冲煞 field, (c) dates that clash with 马 zodiac must be excluded, (d) the exact footer text, (e) all three medal emojis must be present.
